bind.title: Bind Home Assistant to your S2000
bind.description: The S2000 ({name}) needs a one-time local pairing (no Anker account). Press the Power button once on the unit, then submit to register Home Assistant. Note: the S2000 is single-owner, so this replaces the phone app's pairing.
